company.name: Datamode
company.shortDescription: Datamode is a data pipeline visibility tool for data engineers.
company.description: Datamode brings monitoring and context about each pipeline task into a single place so data engineers can quickly find the root cause of problems.  Datamode was started by repeat founders, including a co-founder of Movity, which sold to Trulia in 2010.
